what: 01226 fixed in blaze-query-macros (both trees, tracked_impl.rs): a tracked impl method's NAME is now the contract's `SelfTy::method` (type name without generics, the user's method name; `self_ty` text when given), not the fork's `Modules < 'db >::module_`. That makes the kind tables (hir-ty db.rs ItemBounds::of etc., blaze-item-hash RULES, blaze-items goals.rs) match. In blaze-v2-qu rewrite the ~200 log expectations that copied the fork form, as a recorded replay step: in the listed files replace regex `"([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*)(?: < [^"]*? >)?::([a-z_0-9]+?)_"` with `"\1::\2"` (hir-ty-mir incremental.rs 164, hir-def nameres incremental.rs 28, invalidation.rs 3, source_maps.rs 2; the two doc comments in narrow.rs:33 and cost.rs:77 by hand). Then rg `::[a-z_0-9]+_"` in crates/ should find nothing.
